ownerStory.introTitle: From the green gardens of Ben Tre.
ownerStory.introDescription: Ngoc Ngan Ben Tre is a seedling business from Ben Tre — a land known for lush gardens and traditional farming. Driven by a love of plants and a wish to bring quality varieties to growers, Ngoc Ngan has dedicated the work to selling and supplying seedlings to customers near and far.
ownerStory.introImageAlt: Cai Mon Ben Tre seedlings with guava and durian
ownerStory.journeyParagraph1: From the smallest seedlings, Ngoc Ngan carefully chooses plants that are healthy, true to variety, and suited to each customer’s needs. As the old saying goes: “With enough work grinding iron, one day it becomes a needle.” Building a lasting business likewise takes persistence, diligence, and trust.
ownerStory.journeyParagraph2: Beyond selling seedlings, Ngoc Ngan shares planting and care experience so customers gain practical knowledge for their gardens. For growers, the proverb “First water, second fertilizer, third diligence, fourth variety” remains valuable wisdom — a reminder that many factors must work together for plants to thrive.
ownerStory.journeyParagraph3: Through direct sales and social media, Ngoc Ngan gradually brings Ben Tre seedlings to plant lovers and gardeners. With dedication and a spirit of continuous learning, Ngoc Ngan aims to keep building reputation, raising seedling quality, and helping create greener gardens.
ownerStory.journeyImageAlt: Ngoc Ngan Ben Tre packing healthy seedlings for delivery

ownerPhilosophy.title: Honor the land, love what you grow.
ownerPhilosophy.verse:
Dear friend, do not leave fields fallow —
every inch of land is an inch of gold.
ownerPhilosophy.description: That is the spirit Ngoc Ngan wants to share: respect the land, love the crops, and work with farmers to create lasting value from the gardens of home.
